operations.title: An arbitrary finite terminal kernel has exponent-controlled power compatibility
operations.statement: For q:K->1 with arbitrary finite group K, the power correspondence commutes with coefficient fiber sum and basis-level fiber lift iff gcd(n,exp(K))=1.
operations.scope: Terminal quotient only; arbitrary finite possibly nonabelian kernel; basis-level correspondence.

operations.title: S3 and Q8 terminal power spectrum test
operations.protocol: Enumerate n=1..24 power maps on S3 and Q8 and compare permutation status with gcd(n,exp(K))=1.
operations.falsifier: Any index disagrees with the exponent criterion.

operations.title: Nonabelian terminal-kernel power spectrum research packet

operations.outcome: pass: S3 and Q8 match the exponent criterion across 48 index cases and 2400 exact checks

evidence.paraphrase: Exact S3 and Q8 power-permutation spectra match gcd(n,exp(K))=1.
